<!-- Maintainer and invited-collaborator workflow. Public PR creation is restricted. -->

## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and link the Issue or Discussion that set the
direction.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally.
- [ ] TUI changes were exercised in `npm run tui:lab` at normal and narrow sizes.
- [ ] User-facing behavior and documentation agree.
- [ ] Stable release changes are recorded in `CHANGELOG.md`, or this is not a
      stable release PR.
- [ ] No credentials, private workspace data, generated output, or local-only
      maintainer files are included.
